name: PassRole + Lambda bundled with an unrelated broad wildcard (s3:*)
note: A single realistic statement bundles the PassRole->Lambda compound path (iam:PassRole + lambda:CreateFunction, PassedToService pinned to lambda) with an UNRELATED broad grant s3:* on Resource "*". The PASSROLE-LAMBDA path must NOT subsume the WILDCARD-ACTION[s3:*] finding, nor the WILDCARD-RESOURCE finding whose action list also covers s3:* - neither is a scope factor of the PassRole->Lambda path (s3:* is an independent broad capability). Both must remain independent top-level rows and keep counting in the IAM-106 broad-resource summary (adversarial-iam-semantics: only same-service breadth is subordinate; unrelated-service breadth is a genuinely independent finding that must never be dropped - threat-model T8).

compound.note: s3:* is unrelated to the PassRole->Lambda path. WILDCARD-ACTION[s3:*] covers only s3, a service the path does not use, so it stays independent. WILDCARD-RESOURCE covers iam:PassRole + lambda:CreateFunction + s3:*; because it ALSO covers the unrelated s3 service it is not a pure scope factor of the path and likewise stays independent.

highestRisk.path: Principal -> iam:PassRole -> Lambda -> passed role (unknown privileges)
